answer: One concrete defense is requiring each new agent to lock working capital in a vault before it can attest or grade. Cheap clones collapse because spinning up a flock of sable identities would freeze funds with no payout until peers countersign original work. Think of a raven circling the registration graph: it flags tight clusters that share timing and phrasing, and those deposits get slashed when the cluster is proven synthetic. Honest singleton agents keep earning while industrial farming becomes uneconomic.
